gloss: outline; gist; main thread; general idea

definitions.explanation: The general framework or main points of something, without the details.

examples.japanese: {計画|けいかく}の{大筋|おおすじ}を{説明|せつめい}した。
examples.english: I explained the outline of the plan.

examples.japanese: {大筋|おおすじ}で{合意|ごうい}した。
{映画|えいが}の{大筋|おおすじ}だけ{教|おし}えて。
examples.english: Just tell me the gist of the movie.

notes:
FORMS:
{大|おお} (big, main) + {筋|すじ} (line, thread) → main thread = outline

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {大筋|おおすじ}で - in general terms, in principle
- {大筋|おおすじ}を{説明|せつめい}する - to explain the outline
- {大筋|おおすじ}で{合意|ごうい}する - to agree in principle
- {物語|ものがたり}の{大筋|おおすじ} - the plot outline

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {概略|がいりゃく} - summary, outline
- {概要|がいよう} - overview
- {要旨|ようし} - gist, main point
- あらすじ - plot summary (stories)

USAGE:
{大筋|おおすじ} emphasizes the main flow or structure, leaving aside minor details.
